role: Hash-verifiable owner record of the criteria-fidelity confirmation that PHASE10A_APPROVED_EXIT_CRITERIA_V1.json declares as a hard precondition on roadmap items 1-6. This artifact is the sole authority for that confirmation. The successor gate carries only this artifact's digest, never the approval itself.

confirms.digestBinding: This confirmation is valid ONLY for the criteria artifact whose digest equals criteriaSha256 above. If the approved criteria are ever re-authored, this confirmation lapses by construction and a fresh owner confirmation is required. The successor gate enforces that binding as a DEFINITION-class condition.

ownerRulingVerbatim: I confirm that the Phase-10A successor definitions implementing approved owner decisions D1-D15 are faithful to my intended criteria. This confirms the criteria/provenance definition only.

provenance.whyAdditiveRatherThanEditingTheCriteriaA: PHASE10A_APPROVED_EXIT_CRITERIA_V1.json declares immutable: true, and its digest is pinned by the successor gate and cited by tests/phase10a-closure-v1-successor-gate-1.test.mjs. Its own minimumOwnerActionToClear text describes an alternative path - edit the field in place and re-pin CRITERIA_SHA256 - which would require mutating an artifact that declares itself immutable. The owner instruction for this unit is to prefer a hash-verifiable owner-authorization artifact over hardcoding approval into executable source, so the confirmation is recorded here, additively, and the criteria artifact stays byte-identical. Both paths are hash-verifiable; this one does not require breaking a published immutability declaration.
provenance.resolutionOrderInGate: The gate first reads provenance.ownerConfirmationOfFidelityStatus from the criteria artifact (unchanged mechanism). If that is not CONFIRMED, it reads this artifact - and accepts it only when this artifact is present, digest-pinned, parseable, declares CONFIRMED, and its confirms.criteriaSha256 equals the criteria digest the gate itself pins.

explicitNonImplications.note: Stated by the owner in the same ruling. Recorded verbatim in effect so that no reader, gate, or downstream artifact can inflate this confirmation.

doesNotWaive: D3 anti-circularity: expectation-fitting to previously observed analyzer behavior remains development evidence only and cannot establish closure.
D8: at least one genuinely unseen/holdout/blind post-freeze campaign remains a precondition of item 6 PASS, and no such campaign exists yet.
D10: the additive items 7/8 ledger-row split remains additive; a historical combined row can never produce PASS for a split criterion.
D11: PER_ROW_EVIDENCE_R3.json and PER_ROW_EVIDENCE_R4.json remain DEVELOPMENT_GOVERNANCE, never INDEPENDENT_CLOSURE.
D14: the 145 R3-to-R4 expectation changes remain development-governance history and are not proof of reason closure.
Every EVIDENCE_PRESENCE and CONTENT condition on items 1-6. Clearing the fidelity precondition only removes the precondition; each item still has to be evidenced.
